item.title: Thailand school shooting: teen suspect killed at least seven people and injured more than 30, officials say – latest updates
item.summary: Suspect appeared to have planned deadly attack, Thailand’s PM says as he vows to introduce new gun laws Natasha May is reporting from Nonthaburi on the outskirts of Thailand’s capital, Bangkok From its outskirts, it appears to be a normal day in Nonthaburi but the closer you get to the school, the greater the police presence becomes with large silver vans and officers in uniform everywhere.
